facts.text: I asked for the story to be improved while keeping the story the same.
I wanted the surroundings, feelings, and thoughts to be described more meaningfully.
I wanted the writing to paint a picture in a person's mind.

events.text: Mitne announces he is leaving and that his nextborn egg will be created
Mitne departs and leaves a rainbow-scaled egg behind
The egg hatches the next day and Duulo is born
Duulo guides the forest youth for hundreds of years before the youth set out
Ernaya is named and Duulo heals her eyes after reincarnating as a mortal
The Duulo-Vraktor lineage continues to this day
